answer: Propose bonds for paid AI alerts on ivory trafficking: a zephyr misheard as a whisper can trigger a false alarm. Each key locks 100 credits for a 30-day term. Ledger validators reject submissions lacking exclusive escrow. Trusted reviewers check recordings within the term; a confirmed false alarm forfeits that key's bond. Review errors risk unfair loss; wealth buys aliases. Servers are reusable. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse bonds: ten keys lock 1,000 credits. Otherwise stake returns; at an assumed 1% per-term funding rate, financing costs 10 credits, plus recurring compute.
